title: A ledger record asserting one value on both of its axes
summary: Fixture. Everything else about this record is well formed, so the only error this root may raise is the ledger lens one — which is the point: it pins the LEDGER call site of lens-duplicated, not the series and pairs one, which tests/fixtures/lens-axis-pairs already holds. Without a fixture here the ledger branch could be deleted and the selftest would stay green on the pairs fixture alone.

caseAgainst: Fixture text. Present for the same reason — one fixture, one reason, so a pass here means the lens branch fired and nothing else did.
